A '''blue skinned pirate''' of unidentified species who was part of the crew of [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]].

==Biography==
After discovering [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], who had infiltrated Kybo Ren's hideout on [[Tarnoonga/Legends|Tarnoonga]], this pirate and his two companions were tackled by [[Jann Tosh]], coming to the rescue of his [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. As the droid and his master fled, the angry pirate and his comrades pursued, but were unable to capture the fugitives.

==Behind the scenes==
This pirate appeared only in the book [[The Pirates of Tarnoonga: A Droid Adventure]] and was not present in the [[Pirates of Tarnoonga]] television episode.
The tattoo on the shoulder of the pirate is the emblem of the Pirates of Tarnoonga.
